rows.title_full: AN ACT AMENDING TITLE ELEVEN AND CERTAIN ARTICLES UNDER SAID TITLE OF THE REVISED PENAL CODE, AS AMENDED, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: Amends Title Eleven of the Revised Penal Code to read as "CRIMES AGAINST (Chastity) PERSONAL DIGNITY AND SEXUAL LIBERTY." Amends, further, the title of Chapter Two, Title Eleven and Article 336 of the Revised Penal Code to read as follows: RAPE and(Acts of Lasciviousness) SEXUAL ASSAULT." Provides for the change in penalties and who may file the complaint.
rows.status: Substituted by HB06265

rows.title_full: AN ACT BANNING CIGARETTES/CIGA RS SMOKING IN CERTAIN PUBLIC PLACES
rows.abstract: "Anti-Smoking Act of 1995" Prohibits smoking in all public conveyances and enclosed public places. Provides, however, that smoking areas shall be designated in hotels, restaurants, moviehouses, shopping malls and similar establishments.

rows.title_full: AN ACT TO HARNESS THE REJECT ENERGY EXCESS CAPACITY OF PRIVATELY-OWNED POWER PLANTS AND GENERATING UNITS TO ENCOURAGE THE BUILDING OF SAID PLANTS UNITS, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: "ELECTRIC POWER SHARING AND COGENERATION ACT OF 1993" Proposes to adopt a combination of power-sharing scheme and cogeneration concpet.  This means that the government will have to make use of the excess power capacity of private power plants through the NAPOCOR and NEA.  These power plants should be connected to the distribution system of the nearest public utility, the NAPOCOR grid or the transmission facilities of the NEA.  The latter shall pay for the used excess power capacity.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on ENERGY since 1995-08-29
